report.summary: Patient P-D002 (46, Medicaid with a transport benefit) screens positive for transportation need ("no" reliable transport) at tract 17031300900. Eligible for Medicaid non-emergency medical transportation through Lakeshore Community Health Plan; call the number on the Medicaid card at least 2 business days before appointments. Not eligible for the Senior Shuttle (age 60+). Paratransit certification is an option if ADA-eligible, with decisions taking up to 21 days.
